sentences.en: I want to become more active.
I joined a gym near my home.
sentences.ar: اشتركت في نادٍ رياضي قرب منزلي.

sentences.en: Today is my first workout.
I will start with a warm-up.
The treadmill is available now.
I prefer cycling to running.
How long should I warm up?
I am following a simple plan.
I train three times a week.
I need to improve my stamina.
sentences.ar: أحتاج إلى تحسين قدرتي على التحمل.

sentences.en: I will increase the intensity gradually.
Can you show me how to use this machine?
sentences.ar: هل يمكنك أن تريني طريقة استخدام هذا الجهاز؟

sentences.en: Make sure your back stays straight.
Start with a lighter weight.
I can do ten repetitions.
I need a short rest between sets.
sentences.ar: أحتاج إلى راحة قصيرة بين المجموعات.

sentences.en: My legs feel tired today.
I am working on my technique.
Good form is more important than speed.
I will ask the trainer for advice.
Do not forget to breathe normally.
I brought water and a towel.
I feel stronger than last month.
sentences.ar: أشعر أنني أقوى من الشهر الماضي.

sentences.en: Recovery is part of training.
I will stretch after my workout.
My muscles are a little sore.
I need enough sleep to recover.
Healthy meals support my training.
I am not comparing myself to others.
Everyone starts somewhere.
I am proud of showing up today.
Tomorrow will be a rest day.
I want to build a sustainable habit.
sentences.ar: أريد بناء عادة أستطيع الاستمرار عليها.

sentences.en: One workout at a time.

sections.heading: A new situation
paragraphs: Dina was learning how to handle exercise and the gym in everyday English. The goal was to communicate clearly and politely.
